title: Count Unreachable Pairs of Nodes

monster.name: Void Severer
monster.title: Tallyer of Disjoint Realms
monster.defeatQuote: Total pairs of vertices with no connecting paths counted!

description: You are given an integer `n`. There is an undirected graph with `n` nodes, numbered from 0 to `n - 1`. You are given a 2D integer array `edges` where `edges[i] = [ai, bi]`. Return the number of pairs of different nodes that are unreachable from each other.
starterCode:
def countPairs(n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def countPairs(n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    parent = list(range(n))
    size = [1] * n
    def find(i):
        if parent[i] == i: return i
        parent[i] = find(parent[i])
        return parent[i]
    for u, v in edges:
        ru, rv = find(u), find(v)
        if ru != rv:
            parent[ru] = rv
            size[rv] += size[ru]
    comp_sizes = [size[i] for i in range(n) if parent[i] == i]
    ans = 0
    rem = n
    for s in comp_sizes:
        ans += s * (rem - s)
        rem -= s
    return ans
hints: Find component sizes using DSU. Sum size * (remaining nodes - size) across components.
